title: ze_the_shifting_pool
description: The ride-the-wave minigame: swim through the gaps in the walls coming down a flooded tunnel.

scenarios.name: Ride the wave (minigame)
scenarios.summary: Swim through the gaps in the oncoming walls
scenarios.description: Where trigger_teleport_to_minigame1 puts the humans (dest_mg_wall), as its touch starts relay_mg_wall_begin: you float in the flooded tube (water_mg_wave; moveseg2 is the passing wave you see). Easy walls at +5, 10 and 15 s (mg_chunk_t1-t3), then a random one of 20 every 5 s from timer_mg_wall_clock until counter_mg_wall_chunk_count reaches 10. Each wall is an mg_chunk_* train coming down track_mg_* at 700 u/s from the tube's far end; swim (Space or the wheel up, look up to rise faster, sink by letting go) into its opening. A wall that hits you pushes you back into the human-only trigger_teleport to dest_killroom. Win when relay_mg_wall_end_sequence enables trigger_teleport_mg_wall_complete (9 s after the 10th wall), the tick before it sends you to the island: only the tube is drawn (view), the island and the platform stage are never loaded. Endless: the counter never fills, so walls keep coming.
